tells.1: Even, template-complete architecture: every section the same weight, every bullet neatly closed, no personal aside.
tells.3: Repeated 'Mitigation:' tags and lockstep parallel syntax on every risk.
tells.4: Bold topic labels on every item, including the empty one-word header 'Flexibility.'
tells.5: Systematic casual rewrite that stays perfectly parallel, with off phrases like 'How they do depends' and 'I'm glad to walk through.'

reason: Version 2 is the only draft with unedited human texture, so it ranks first, but I would send version 1: it is clear and credible without 3 and 4's label scaffolding or 5's slightly forced plain-language pass.
